candidates.statement: Gateway checkout POSTs return 502 because the downstream order service returns 500 on POST /v1/orders; traces and logs show the gateway's client call to order failing with 500, propagating as 502 to /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side root cause (pool, redis, payment) not observed; only gateway-side evidence available.

report.explanation: Gateway observations show consistent 502 on /v1/checkout with fast failures, and traces/logs tie each 502 to a 500 from the order service on POST /v1/orders. The bounded candidate is an order-service 500 propagating through the gateway; the specific order-side fault is not yet established.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/traces for POST /v1/orders 500 to identify the failing dependency
Order service metrics for db pool, redis, and payment dependency outcomes
Inventory/payment/postgresql telemetry to rule out downstream causes
